items.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued November 27 at 2:28PM PST until November 27 at 5:00PM PST by NWS Portland OR
items.description:
* WHAT...Tidal overflow flooding.

* WHERE...Clatsop County Coast.

* WHEN...Until 5 PM PST this afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding, up to one foot above ground level,
during high tides is expected in the low lying areas near bays,
sloughs, and the lower reaches of the coastal rivers.
items.instruction:
A Coastal Flood Advisory means that tidal overflow flooding is
expected. Coastal residents in the warned area should be alert
for rising water, and take appropriate action to protect life and
property.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 27 at 12:27PM PST until November 28 at 1:00AM PST by NWS Portland OR
items.description:
* WHAT...Seas 8 to 12 ft at 16 seconds and north winds 5 to 15
kt.

* WHERE...Coastal Waters from Cape Shoalwater to Florence out 60
NM.

* WHEN...Until 1 AM PST Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
